title: Your website changes. Your SEO needs to keep up.
narration: Your website changes all the time. Your SEO needs to keep up.

title: A new homepage. A broken next step.
narration: Your team merges a homepage update. It looks good, but the main shopping button now leads to a missing page.

title: The agent confirms what needs attention.
narration: Your Optimiser checks the changed page and follows its links. It confirms the broken link and a missing page description.

title: Keep the design. Repair the problem.
narration: The agent reads the existing website, restores the working link, and writes a description using the page's own content. It tests the proposed changes.

title: A clear fix. Your decision.
narration: Your team reviews a focused fix, with a clear explanation of what changed and why. You choose when it goes live.

title: The fix is live. Does it actually work?
narration: After deployment, the agent checks the website again. The collection opens, and the page description is restored. That closes this issue.

title: Nothing broken? Nothing to rewrite.
narration: The next update only changes the spacing. Your Optimiser checks it and leaves it alone. No unnecessary fix or review.

title: You keep building. We keep watching.
narration: Checks continue between updates, too. Your team keeps building. Your Optimiser keeps watching.
